prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished final-art visual concept for a landscape Chinese wuxia mobile game, with richly authored hand-painted art direction, restrained ornament, impeccable typography and hierarchy. A full-screen 16:9 game screenshot, not a physical phone, not a web dashboard, no presentation annotations. Visual system: warm soot-black and umber ink, ivory aged silk, dry parchment fibres, engraved antique bronze, vermilion mineral pigment and sparse mellow gold. Warm neutral materials with subtle depth, soft contact shadows, ink feathering and carefully controlled wear. Never a flat navy-blue, petrol-blue or teal UI background. No glassmorphism, generic thin outline rectangles or circles, keyboard shortcuts, mouse cursor, hover states, long instructional paragraphs, Latin labels, browser chrome, red annotation arrows or lorem ipsum. Chinese main titles in beautiful confident brush calligraphy; supporting Chinese short and clean, genuinely legible. Touch controls large enough for a mobile screen. Content restrained with valuable space left to artwork. Consistent baseline positions for card controls.
Input image: composition and existing gameplay art reference, NOT an approved UI style. Redesign every UI area identified by red arrows; erase all arrows. Preserve the current actual hand-painted game world: the blue-robed swordsman at the tent and glowing campfire on upper left, woodland clearing, formation spells across the clearing, a natural river at right. Preserve the original 2D brush-painted character scale and oblique game camera. Enrich the lighting with warm campfire, earthy foliage, subtle neutral ink shadows; river can retain natural muted blue-green but UI surfaces must not. Extend the scenery cleanly to both screen edges, replacing the two dead navy side gutters with illustrated forest silhouettes and warm neutral ink edge treatments. Playable area occupies most of the screen and is not obstructed.
Composition: compact upper-left title 山野·阵火 on a weathered dark umber ink stroke, ivory calligraphy. Under this, a distinctive substantial vertical bronze-and-ochre formation talisman: large calligraphic 阵 and clear 布阵, with a beautiful engraved mountain / formation sigil behind it; one compact pale-silk status ribbon reading 纯阵合鸣. Remove the old long passive mechanics descriptions. Small meaningful elemental pips and counts under the talisman, no paragraphs.
Upper-right resources 灵力 14 and 营地 70 expressed as elegant small inlaid bronze gauges, a short 第2波 status and a single tactile dark bronze pause medallion, not a row of outline circles.
Bottom: five equally aligned authored parchment talisman cards with the existing elemental ink paintings (twisting root, fire, mountain, metal slash, water vortex), crisp short labels 盘根 / 焚野 / 垒土 / 鸣锋 / 回澜. Narrow crafted antiqued edges and slight paper depth, active fire card indicated by vermilion stamp and thin gold inner glow without lifting its baseline. Remove keyboard number labels. Cards take roughly the middle 55% of screen width and 19% height. To the right tactile parchment/bronze secondary buttons 修营 and 撤阵, and a broad wonderfully painted cinnabar-lacquer brush seal primary button 迎战 with an ivory arrow. Minimal copy, genuine premium game art, no blue rectangular backgrounds behind buttons. Show a cohesive plausible implementable in-game interface, not a cinematic poster.

Input image: information/content reference only, NOT approved layout, colours, borders or overlap. Reimagine this build screen as a magnificent laid-open martial manuscript on textured warm charcoal / umber cloth, entirely replacing the dark blue panel with warm ivory and aged silk throughout, from title through content through footer. Thin scroll-rod edges, subtle stitched borders and uneven ink-wash material transitions, no gaudy palace decoration.
Layout: 16:9 landscape, a generously sized manuscript occupies 92% of frame. Top title 双命同修 in deep warm black brush calligraphy, very small 构筑 above. Tactile small bronze close control at top right.
Left 26% forms an impressive class identity page: huge stylised calligraphic 阵 in ochre gold over a gorgeous misty mountain-and-concentric formation illustration, visible clear title 布阵 underneath and a tiny cinnabar seal. This is the visual anchor so the class reads instantly. Short subordinate 修为 0 and 尚未觉醒. At the bottom of this left area, three small carefully spaced affinity medallions 木 +12% / 火 +12% / 金 +12%, naturally printed into the manuscript, no rectangular chips.
Right 68%: two large equally sized talent leaves side by side with generous original ink paintings in their upper half. First art is a guardian beast emerging from a gold formation, title 阵中藏灵 with a small ochre 阵印; one short line 共守阵势. Second art is lifted mountain slabs with golden ley lines, title 移山换阵, short line 每次 10 灵力. All pictures cleanly separated from typography. Tiny chevrons on each leaf for tap details. Painted paper frames and golden silk tabs, keep words readable.
Below these talent leaves a restrained ink divider and one neat learned-technique band with a small mist / tide painted emblem, title 沸雾还潮, small 1重, concise numeric effect 湿雾 2.4s. A small bound-manual tab labelled 阵势手册 at the lower edge. Footer is the same warm manuscript material with a tactile red brush-stamp 返回 at bottom left and understated small 重新启程 at bottom right. Fill the layout intentionally, no huge empty dark fields. All warm and neutral, no blue surfaces, no existing overlapping icon/text.

Make the 五行手记 help screen feel like a carefully illustrated ancient practice folio laid open, entire content surface ivory paper and pale ochre silk, standing against a narrow textured soot-black / umber cloth surround. The page itself is clean for readability, decorative ink concentrated at corners, subtle antique-bronze page weights, binding fold. Landscape mobile screen, no desktop layout.
Top left large elegant calligraphy 五行手记 with a small vermilion stamp. Top right single tactile bronze close control. Below title, four generous bound-paper chapter tabs 基础 / 连招 / 御灵 / 阵势; active 基础 has a vermilion brush underline. No long accordion rows.
Three large side-by-side illustrated studies directly printed onto the continuous warm manuscript page, separated by faint hand-drawn vertical ink rules, never blue inset boxes. First heading 圈地成阵: beautiful coloured ink illustration of an encircling brush stroke enclosing small glowing bronze formation stones and rooted wood, small human fingertip touch gesture mark integrated subtly. One short caption 首尾相接，落笔成阵. Second heading 划线出招: lively but uncluttered original painted scene of the same blue-robed young wandering swordsman sweeping a vermilion stroke toward a wolf, with no boxed dark background; picture feathering into the paper. Caption 短划省灵，长划增威. Third heading 停时齐发: frozen grey ink wolves surrounded by three beautiful suspended golden-red sword strokes, a clear small 3s numerical seal and one short caption 停时三秒，双倍齐发. Strong illustration as explanation; restrained concise text.
Bottom has three small meaningful flow emblems only, plenty of breathing space, and tactile vermilion brush-seal 返回. Cohesive craft with the warm parchment-and-antique-bronze build screen and battlefield talismans. No Q, spacebar, mouse/hover hints, no technical explanation blocks, no cold blue panel background.
